cards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE square full-bleed character illustration for Project: Prowl's established medieval elemental CAT CARD COLLECTION.
Input images: all supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets and not character designs to copy. Create a NEW character. Images 1–3 are existing Sizzle Mittens, Whisker Whirl and Moatgate Mau cards; image 4 is the existing Charmae Emberhem Rally illustration.
Style requirement: look like the SAME ARTIST drew every card in this collection. Original 2D fantasy-adventure production cartoon, bold warm-black outer contours, thinner purposeful interior lines, smooth MATTE FLAT colour fills, exactly one simple hard-edged shadow per major form, one small flat highlight at most. Large expressive feline eyes with simple pupils, broad short cat muzzles, compact oversized heads, ROUND SHORT TORSOS, short feline limbs and broad haunches. Fur is simplified silhouette tufts/colour masses, NEVER individual strands. Do not soften the shading. No grain, paper texture, mottled colour, hatching, painterly rendering, gradients, bloom, airbrush, realistic reflections or glossy 3D. Cloth, wood, bread, water, wicker and stone are clean cartoon shapes.
Composition: square 1254x1254, full character and main props inside the canvas. Large face with BOTH eyes visible in the upper-middle, clear of the upper-left element badge zone and upper-right Power badge zone. Main prop close below the face, readable in a shallow landscape crop. No cropped ears, tail or paws. Minimal shallow background: one broad flat elemental circle and no more than three simple supporting motifs. Common rarity means modest equipment/magic, NOT worse artwork.
Anatomy gate: exactly ONE head, ONE torso, ONE tail, TWO forelegs attached to shoulders and TWO hind legs attached to haunches. A prop-holding foreleg replaces a planted front leg; never add a fifth limb. Both rear paws must have clear continuous short leg connections, not floating or detached feet. Paws are rounded feline mitten shapes with at most three broad toe divisions, no human fingers, no opposable human thumbs, no human footwear. Make contacts/occlusions deliberate and readable.

Subject: LUCAN CRUSTKEEPER, male Fire Common Rally field baker, based on the approved Lucas concept. A cheerful compact Singapura cat with warm light-sepia fur, deeper brown ear tips and nose, large upright feline ears, bright GREEN eyes, short broad cream muzzle and a proud slightly smug closed-mouth grin. NO orange tabby stripes, no calico patches. Rounded little body and very short legs, same proportions as the supplied cats.
Costume: a SHORT brick-red medieval baker's smock, a simple cream folded-back linen cap worn between the ears (both ears unobscured, NOT a tall modern chef's toque), and a cream waist apron lightly flour-dusted using only two small flat marks. Broad simple tailoring; no cape, scarf, armour or modern chef uniform.
Action: sitting securely on his haunches in a slight three-quarter turn, both short hind legs emerging clearly below the short apron with TWO naturally connected rounded rear paws resting on the ground. Both short forelegs bend forward from shoulders to TWO separate paws offering ONE shallow oval wooden bread tray at lower chest height. Each paw supports a different outside edge of that SAME tray. Exactly THREE chunky golden round bread rolls sit securely on the tray, one large simple scoring slash on each. The tray has one continuous balanced rim and a coherent visible shallow side face, not disjointed wood or a huge table. ONE small crisp orange-and-gold flame curls just under the tray centre to keep bread warm, with clear separation from the paws. No blazing furnace, no smoke hiding the anatomy, no second tray. ONE slim sepia tail gently curls beside his haunch.
Palette/background: warm cream field, ONE broad uniform brick-red circle. A simplified roadside bread stall hinted at by a small plain wooden counter edge and ONE little hanging loaf-shaped wooden sign with no writing. No hearth, oven, bellows, clutter, village panorama or castle. Friendly generosity and cosy fire magic; the face/tray/three bread rolls are the main focus. Match the references' restrained flat illustration finish exactly.

Primary request: redesign Siewen as SIEWEN RAINKEEPER, a male Water COMMON RALLY village rain collector. Keep the SAME adorable cream-and-caramel LaPerm cat identity from image 1: same broad rounded feline face, large AMBER eyes, short cream muzzle and pink nose, cream-and-caramel fur pattern, a handful of grouped curled cheek tufts, one softly curled bushy cream/caramel tail and cheerful knowing smile. Redesign his JOB, CLOTHING, POSE, PROPS and simple environment completely. Remove ALL reedworking tools, reeds and baskets. He is no longer a basket-maker.

Costume: an oversized but practical BROAD-BRIMMED NAVY FELT TRAVELLING RAIN HAT, simple pale-blue hatband, low rounded crown, with BOTH real feline ears protruding through two snug openings in the crown. The crown and brim are one coherent felt structure; NOT floating pieces, duplicate ears, a wizard cone, pirate tricorn, modern yellow rain hat, armour or helmet. Brim frames the face without hiding either amber eye. SHORT navy medieval wool tunic with broad pale-blue SIDE PANELS, one small plain cream front neck fastening and a simple rope belt. Short bare cream forelegs or very short cuffs: paws remain clear. The tunic hem ends above the hind-leg joints. No apron, robe, cape, scarf, modern raincoat, boots, jewellery or elaborate ornaments.

Pose and action: a low asymmetrical three-quarter crouch with broad feline haunches, round SHORT torso and VERY SHORT connected hind legs. Cute squat cat proportions, not a tall human. BOTH cream hind paws are grounded with visible short continuous connections to the haunches; naturally one is nearer and one is further away, no dragging/disconnected foot. TWO forelegs only, each clearly attached to a shoulder. One short foreleg extends to support ONE shallow royal-blue CERAMIC BASIN just below chest height and slightly to his side; its cream paw visibly cups the basin's underside/rim, a simple rounded feline mitten grip. The OTHER short foreleg raises its cream paw next to and ABOVE the basin to guide the falling rain. This raised forepaw REPLACES the second planted foreleg; never add a fifth limb. Raised paw has one coherent grouped cat shape and at most three broad toe groups, no human thumb/fingers.
Basin geometry: ONE shallow broad bowl with one continuous balanced oval rim and an open clearly visible blue water surface, simple pale-blue interior and one cream rim stripe. No handle, ornate decorations, wicker or woodgrain, no broken/disjointed edges. Keep the basin and guided rain immediately below/beside the face so the profession remains readable in the card window.

Rain effect: ONE SMALL pale-blue/cream flat cartoon raincloud drifting to the side above the basin, never overlapping his face, hat or limbs. About five broad clean blue raindrops fall into ONE curved royal-blue-and-white water arc that follows the guiding paw and ENTERS the SAME basin. Two small graphic splash lobes at the landing point. Practical modest water magic, not a huge storm, tornado, translucent laser ribbon, realistic spray, dozens of particles or glowing bloom. Water arc must connect cloud/drop direction to bowl clearly and not look like a loose handle or disconnected reed. He looks pleased and resourceful, with a cheeky closed-mouth grin.

Style: match the SAME ARTIST and production finish as the supplied existing collection. Bold warm-black outer contours; thinner sparse intentional interior lines. Completely smooth MATTE FLAT base colours, exactly ONE clean HARD-EDGED cel shadow per major form and at most one small flat highlight. Simple large expressive cat eyes and small short muzzles. Fur is grouped curls/tufts and colour masses, not individual strands. Cloth, felt, ceramic, cloud, stone and water are clean graphic shapes. NO texture noise, paper grain, mottling, hatching, painterly rendering, airbrush, soft gradients, glossy 3D or realistic lighting.

Background/composition: square 1254x1254, full ears, hat, tail and all FOUR paws inside frame with breathing room. Large face in the UPPER-MIDDLE of the square, both eyes clear of the game's upper-left element badge and upper-right Power badge areas. Keep the rain action in the upper-middle/right rather than a large empty landscape. Pale-aqua field with ONE uniform navy/teal background circle. Only a low simple stone roadside ledge and ONE broad shallow puddle shape below him. No extra rain barrels, baskets, buildings, distant scenery, reeds, background cats or silhouettes. Common status means modest equipment and elemental spectacle, not a different or lower-quality art style.

Anatomy gate: ONE head, ONE torso, ONE tail, TWO forelegs continuously connected to shoulders and TWO hind legs connected to haunches, FOUR total feline limbs. Simple rounded cat paws, coherent prop support, no extra fingers/toes, floating paws, extra foot behind the bowl or limb-like cloth folds. New rainkeeper outfit and new pose allowed; keep the LaPerm identity, cream/caramel coat, amber eyes and established collection finish.
Output: ARTWORK ONLY, no card frame, lettering, name, numbers, UI, logo, watermark or signature.
cards.anatomyReview: Visual review: two short connected forelegs, one supporting the underside of the continuous ceramic basin and the other raised to guide rain; two grounded hind paws with visible short connections to the haunches beneath the tunic. One connected cream-and-caramel tail. Four feline limbs total; no obvious detached paw, extra leg or disjointed basin rim.
